planets.name: TOI-4633 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4633 with a 272-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-4633 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4633. Its orbit and size follow Eisner et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
